<thought>From the ¹H NMR spectrum, the singlet at 2.22 ppm integrates to 6 H, indicating two equivalent CH₃ groups. The singlet at 2.32 ppm also integrates to 6 H, indicating another two CH₃ groups. No other signals correspond to methyl protons. Therefore, the molecule contains a total of 4 methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
